_why: Writer A, the spare one: a cooler temperature for controlled, image-led pages. Give the two writers different models as well if you can: that is the cheapest real divergence there is. The longest output in the room, so a big token budget and a long timeout.
_help: Committed. Provider and model are usually set in the UI (⚙ Model). null = the .env default. API keys never go here: they're saved per provider in secrets/keys.json.
